note: Only verified mappings are listed. Clip names are numbers (KAS00111_KAS), NOT DOA move names (P/6P/3P) — no source maps numbers to DOA moves, so no fight move is mapped to a clip here. Do not guess mappings. The 6 repo DOA kits keep their community-movelist anim_refs (doa:<fighter>/<move>); wiring kits to numbered clips needs a number->move mapping source that does not exist yet.
skeleton: game/assets/anim/doa6/skeleton.json (GTA:SA ped; retarget to WH rigs is a separate job, not done here)
